source.problem:
Find the number of real solutions $(x,y,z,w)$ of the simultaneous equations
\begin{align*}
2y &= x + \frac{17}{x}, \\
2z &= y + \frac{17}{y}, \\
2w &= z + \frac{17}{z}, \\
2x &= w + \frac{17}{w}.
\end{align*}
source.source_role: MATH context and exact worked-solution assertion anchoring an invariant-level transition probe
